notes: All required story categories already covered (schema, logic, API, tests, integration). No new stories created to avoid duplication; refinement applied.

change_log.value: Expanded to explicitly define scoring mapping table (Phase I=low, II=mid, III=high, IV=highest) and hybrid weighting rules (e.g., I/II midpoint).
Added requirement to normalize multiple source fields (phase, study_phase, text variants) and enforce strict enum output.

change_log.note: Tests depend on schema and logic

change_log.value: Expanded to validate explainability text consistency with score and phase normalization in final payload.

EVAL-CT-M1-S1.title: Define Trial Phase Quality Schema and Scoring Contract
EVAL-CT-M1-S1.description: Define normalized schema: {phase_raw, phase_normalized (I–IV), score (0–1), label, explanation} and deterministic mapping rules including handling for Phase I/II and II/III hybrids. Include explicit scoring table (Phase I=lowest, Phase IV=highest) and midpoint rules for hybrids.

EVAL-CT-M1-S2.title: Implement Trial Phase Extraction and Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M1-S2.description: Implement extraction from ClinicalTrials.gov fields, normalize variants (e.g., 'Phase 1', 'Phase I/II'), map to score, and default handling for missing/unknown with explicit 'unknown' label and neutral score. Normalize across multiple possible source fields and enforce strict enum output.

EVAL-CT-M1-S3.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M1-S3.description: Augment EvaluateCare facade response with {phase_normalized, score, label, explanation} per trial, ensuring backward-compatible payload structure.

EVAL-CT-M1-S4.title: Unit Tests for Trial Phase Quality Logic
EVAL-CT-M1-S4.description: Unit tests for mapping table, hybrid phases, unknown/missing values, and deterministic scoring outputs.

EVAL-CT-M1-S5.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Trial Phase Quality
EVAL-CT-M1-S5.description: Validate that trial phase quality flows from ClinicalTrials.gov API through domain service, scoring logic, and EvaluateCare facade into final response payload, including consistency between score, normalized phase, and explanation text.
